title: When the Harbor Burns
author: Petra Iversen
blurb: Vesper Hartwell, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
